excerpt_i18n.en: Currently, artificial intelligence (AI) is deeply integrating into the investment processes of capital markets, serving as a core driver for the transformation and upgrading of the private equity industry. According to industry sources, subjective strategy stock private equity firms, which previously relied on in-depth research and experience-based judgment for operations, are now accelerating the adoption of AI technology to enhance fund managers' capital management capacity and research coverage boundaries. Many subjective strategy private equity firms have already broken the traditional notion that "AI is only suitable for quantitative investing." Industry insiders believe that the penetration rate of AI in the subjective strategy private equity sector will continue to rise, not only empowering traditional private equity institutions but also potentially giving rise to entirely new forms of private equity entities. (Securities Times)
excerpt_i18n.es: Actualmente, la inteligencia artificial (IA) se está integrando profundamente en los procesos de inversión del mercado de capitales, convirtiéndose en el motor central de la transformación y actualización de la industria de fondos de inversión privados. Según información del sector, los fondos de inversión privados de estrategia subjetiva, que antes operaban basándose en investigaciones profundas y juicios empíricos, ahora están acelerando la adopción de tecnología de IA para ampliar el radio de gestión de capital y el alcance de investigación de los gestores de fondos. Muchos fondos de estrategia subjetiva ya han superado la idea preconcebida de que "la IA solo es adecuada para la inversión cuantitativa". Los expertos del sector consideran que la penetración de la IA en el ámbito de los fondos de estrategia subjetiva seguirá aumentando, lo que no solo potenciará a las instituciones tradicionales de fondos privados, sino que incluso podría dar lugar a nuevas formas de entidades de fondos privados. (Securities Times)

items.title: 从诺奖项目到生成式药物设计，Latent Labs 创始人 Simon Kohl：AI 正在让生物学进入「可编程时代」 | CVPR 2026
items.raw_excerpt: 作者｜吴思梦 编辑｜岑峰   2026年6月3日，计算机视觉与模式识别顶级会议（CVPR）在美国丹佛举行。在大会特邀演讲环节，前 DeepMind 蛋白质设计团队核心成员、2024年诺贝尔化学奖获奖项目 AlphaFold 核心研究员，Latent Labs 创始人兼 CEO Simon Kohl 发表了题为“ Programmable Biology ： Generative AI for Molecular Design ”的精彩演讲。 围绕当今药物发现领域最核心的痛点：一种新药从研发到上市平均耗时超过10年、花费超20亿美元，但九成候选药物最终失败 。 而Simon Kohl认为，这一切的根源在于“我们从错误的分子出发”。为此，他提出了一条从“结构预测”到“条件生成”再到“自主智能体”的技术跃迁路线。 演讲以AlphaFold 2为起点，回顾了蛋白质结构预测突破如何催生生成式药物设计；随后展示了Latent Labs的两代基础模型—— Latent—X1 （通用蛋白结合物设计）与 Latent—X2 （零样本抗体设计）——如何在湿实验室中实现媲美甚至超越传统万亿级筛选的命中率和亲和力；最终发布了全球首个实验室验证的抗体设计智能体 Latent—Y ，仅需一条自然语言提示，即可自主完成从靶点分析到分子设计的全流程。 总结而言，从AlphaFold 2解决“序列到结构”的预测问题，到生成式AI实现“靶点到药物”的条件设计，再到智能体接管“端到端”的自主设计闭环——计算药物设计正以指数级速度演进，Simon Kohl断言： 生物学终将成为可编程的工程学科。   以下是Simon Kohl在CVPR 2026大会上发表的演讲精编稿，雷峰网·AI科技评论基于原英文演讲内容进行了不改原意的翻译编辑：   《 Programmable Biology

excerpt_i18n.en: Author | Wu Simeng Editor | Cen Feng June 3, 2026, the top conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) was held in Denver, USA. During the invited keynote session, Simon Kohl, former core member of the DeepMind protein design team, core researcher of the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry-winning AlphaFold project, and founder and CEO of Latent Labs, delivered a compelling speech titled "Programmable Biology: Generative AI for Molecular Design." He addressed the most critical pain point in drug discovery today: developing a new drug from research to market takes over 10 years on average and costs more than $2 billion, yet 90% of drug candidates ultimately fail. Simon Kohl argued that the root cause lies in "starting from the wrong molecules." To tackle this, he proposed a technological evolution path from "structure prediction" to "conditional generation" and then to "autonomous agents." The speech began with AlphaFold 2, reviewing how breakthroughs in protein structure prediction have catalyzed generative drug design. It then showcased Latent Labs' two generations of foundation models—Latent-X1 (general protein binder design) and Latent-X2 (zero-shot antibody design)—demonstrating how they achieve performance comparable to or even surpassing traditional trillion-scale screening in wet labs.
